payload.text: hv 29 Oct (folds 31-33): hv runs every full suite, push, cut, tag and deploy; a Claude may run a small targeted proof of its own fix, booked on the estate desk. Laksa and Conflab are held for code. For Molt's cuts (their gates, tag and pushes), hv's decision 10 of 23 Nov replaces it: a seat runs them on hv's word.
